author: Jimmy Parker
title: New Details Emerge After Dolly Parton's Death at 80
text:
A Family Announcement for an American Original
More details are now emerging after the death of Dolly Parton, who passed away at age 80. According to the report, her passing was announced on her Instagram account in a video from her nephew, Brian Seaver, who spoke on behalf of the Parton family. Seaver identified himself as the son of Cassie Parton and said he was representing the Parton and Owens family. In the announcement, he referred to her by her full name, Dolly Rebecca Parton Dean, and also by the family names that showed how deeply loved she was: Sister, Sis, Granny to one generation, and Gigi to the next.
No Official Cause of Death Released
A cause of death was not released in the family announcement. The report notes that Parton had been dealing with health problems, including kidney stones and related infections. Her death comes after another painful loss for the family, as her husband, Carl Thomas Dean, passed away in March 2025 at age 82. Parton and Dean were famously private about much of their life together, but their long marriage was a major part of her story. For fans who admired her music, faith, grit, and loyalty to her roots, this is the kind of news that stops the room cold.
Hospitalization Reported Days Before Her Passing
TMZ reported that Parton was admitted to Vanderbilt University Medical Center in Nashville early Friday morning because of kidney and autoimmune issues. That was four days before her death. The same report said she died in the hospital on Tuesday morning. Family members were reportedly hit with a “sudden and unexpected shock,” which makes the news even harder. Even when a public figure is beloved across generations, the private grief still belongs first to the family, and this family has now endured the loss of both Carl and Dolly in a relatively short span of time.
Parton Had Acknowledged Recent Health Issues
Adding another sad layer, Parton spoke about her health in an interview with PEOPLE on the same day she was hospitalized. “I am dealing with some health issues that I just didn’t pay attention to when I was watching over Carl,” she said on Friday. That one sentence says a great deal about the woman so many Americans respected: devoted, tough, and focused on caring for someone she loved. Her passing leaves a major hole in American music and culture, but the report notes the comforting thought that Dolly is now together again with Carl.
